summary: Feed c005_nic is degraded: IDS eth1 is discarding 4.44% of packets (248,280 packets) because its 1G capture interface cannot keep up, causing detection gaps. Physical link is healthy.

findings.root_cause: Tool-side oversubscription / capture overload at IDS eth1. Link is healthy, but the IDS capture path discarded 4.44% of packets it received, well above 0.1% threshold, indicating offered load exceeds the 1 Gbps tool port / capture pipeline capacity.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS with needs_both_directions=true and needs_full_payload=true will miss ~1 in 22 packets/flows. Results in broken TCP reassembly, missed signatures, and attacker evasion - high risk of false negatives.

params.method: packet-broker load balancing to multiple IDS instances/ports

recommended_fix.why: Distribute traffic across multiple 1G tool ports or scale to higher-capacity capture (e.g., 10G) via broker load-balancing so per-interface rate stays below 1Gbps and discards stop. Do not slice payload as IDS requires full payload. Filtering is alternative if load-balancing not possible, but reduces coverage.
